title: RAW UNREVIEWED: a shared abbreviated stem denotes a material in one construction and an action using it in another
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_TESTED. A natural abbreviation channel can obscure the difference between a commodity noun and a related verb. Jointly recover the written expansion and the complete instruction's patient/medium relation; compare a derived action reading with a repeated ingredient-list reading. Commodity concept tags must not supply noun POS or an oracle verb meaning.

design.production_mechanism: A compiler uses the same domain vocabulary as ingredient names and as instructions using those ingredients; abbreviation can hide grammatical material while preserving part of the shared stem. This is a conditional writing model, not an assertion that a specific Voynich suffix marks an imperative.
design.owned_source: research_registry/proposals/production_origin_supply_20261003/ORDERED_PROCEDURAL_LEXICAL_RELATION_REVIEW.json preserves complete CoReMA b6.6 and its wirtz sie woll clause. The ingredient-tagged wirtz is an imperative realization of the spice concept. That particular token has NOT been established as an abbreviation here; it supplies a content distinction, not a native sign example.
design.writing_constraint: Use only the separately verified carrier/sign representation, with visually identical abbreviation signs collapsed regardless of their expanded values. One shared forward channel must write all occurrences. Gold commodity IDs, POS labels, expansions and action arguments cannot become decoder inputs. No posthoc special rule may be added for an imperative occurrence.
design.finite_content_contrast: MATERIAL_LIST introduces another material participant. MATERIAL_DERIVED_ACTION operates on an already introduced patient and uses the material concept as the operation's content. In b6.6 the latter retains seasoning of the prepared liver before wrapping/coating; the former merely adds an item and leaves that action absent. Both must retain the complete recipe, pronoun ambiguities and damaged opener; no omitted action is inserted into the list rival by commentary.
design.positive_knowledge_used: GDT1160 establishes conditional contextual disambiguation with supplied expansion domains; GDT608 requires directed components plus whole-form residuals. These motivate joint writing-and-content accounts but establish neither native homography nor a particular source language.
design.conditional_target_use: If a separately selected natural-channel experiment supplies a bounded set of candidate readings, inspect complete competing passages for this action-versus-material difference, retaining all runner-up bindings. Do not build another decoder here. Existing GDT948 complete material/process accounts are a later native authoring comparison, not seed lexemes.
design.word_profile_contract: No Voynich forms are assigned here. Any candidate native material or action reading must first explain exact-form frequency, section/leaf distribution, grammatical positions and repetition across the existing complete-context burden, without pooling readers or embedded strings.
closest_predecessors: The owned ordered-procedural review declined an oracle action/ingredient assay because both outcomes left the native decision unchanged. This proposal is conditional on a genuinely recovered common writing channel; it does not restart that assay.
GDT1159 commodity-graph failure remains; commodity tags may legitimately cover verbs and are not annotation errors.
GDT832 REPORT read: context helped wholeword recovery but co-lemma factor added no gain and the fixed recovery criterion failed. A shared stem alone is not the proposed semantic selector.
design.likely_failure: A correct-looking verbal expansion may still leave patient binding ambiguous, or a globally equivalent noun/verb analysis may survive. Missing informative abbreviation sites could leave the source example irrelevant to the new channel. Neither outcome licenses guessing an action from a picture.
design.next_step: After a separately frozen channel result, retain one complete source passage with materially different noun/action candidate expansions and compare its full written argument consequences. If no such competing source readings exist, park this consumer rather than manufacturing ambiguity.
design.access_and_review: RAW unreviewed. Existing route/topic, bounded duplicate searches and832/owned source review only. No target/source acquisition, source payload extraction, fits, reserve access, contacts or root experiment changes.
